identity.title: Lua Llama
identity.summary: Pure Lua 5.3+ implementation of LLaMA-style transformer inference that runs CPU-only generation from binary model and tokenizer checkpoints.
identity.subtitle: LLaMA inference from scratch in pure Lua

architecture: CLI entry point parses args and orchestrates model + tokenizer loading
Binary model checkpoint parsed into weight tensors and config struct
Tokenizer loaded from binary file with encode/decode support
Forward pass runs full transformer layers with attention and feed-forward blocks
KV-cache maintained across autoregressive decoding steps
Token sampling with configurable temperature drives generation loop

snippets.label: CLI Entry
snippets.summary: Parses CLI args (model path, tokenizer path, prompt, max_tokens, temperature) and drives the full generation pipeline.

snippets.label: Model Loading
snippets.summary: Reads binary checkpoint files, parses the config header, and loads all transformer weight tensors into Lua tables.

snippets.label: Generation Loop
snippets.summary: Runs the autoregressive decode loop: forward pass, KV-cache update, and temperature-controlled token sampling.

snippets.label: Tokenizer
snippets.summary: Loads vocabulary and merge rules from a binary tokenizer file, with encode and decode methods for prompt/output handling.

snippets.label: Transformer Block
snippets.summary: Implements the core transformer layer: RMS norm, multi-head self-attention, rotary embeddings, and feed-forward network.

notes: Educational runtime only — not a production inference service; no BLAS, SIMD, or batching.
Requires Lua 5.3+ for string.unpack; tested against Lua 5.4 and compatible with stories15M.bin from karpathy/llama2.c.
All computation is CPU-only and driven entirely from Lua with no C extensions or FFI.
Model and tokenizer are loaded from raw binary files; weights are stored as plain Lua tables of floats.
Studio should present this primarily as Source + Notes; no live runtime surface unless a web wrapper is added.
